info.name: Ahlena Admin — Ratings
info.description: F7 rating-visibility moderation for caregiver ratings (CaregiverReviewAdmin) and Care Home ratings (CareHomesOperationalAdmin). Both policies are Normal access with account_type SuperAdmin (5) or SupportAdmin (7); ContentAdmin, FinanceAdmin, Care Home owners (8), Family, Elderly and Caregiver tokens are denied with 403 and a missing or non-Normal token with 401. Hide, keep and restore return 204 and never mutate the retained stars, text or authorship; a Care Home rating's open owner flag is resolved by hide or keep in the same transaction. All failures are validated in the order not-found (404) then reason/filter (400) then illegal transition (409), so a bad reason never masks a missing rating. These examples are authored, not runtime evidence; run only against disposable local fixtures.

request.description: CaregiverReviewAdmin. Reads every caregiver rating, visible and hidden, newest-first by createdOnUtc then rating id. Paging and filters are validated, never clamped: page below 1, pageSize outside 1-100, stars outside 1-5 or an unknown moderation value is 400 Caregivers.Rating.InvalidQuery. moderation accepts visible, hidden or all (case-insensitive; default all) and caregiverId filters to one caregiver, where a well-formed but unknown id returns an empty page rather than an error. Each item carries ratingId, caregiverId, bookingId, familyId, stars, reviewText, createdOnUtc, updatedOnUtc, moderationState (visible or hidden), hiddenByUserId, hiddenOnUtc and hideReason; no reviewer name, phone, email or avatar is ever projected.

exec: pm.test('caregiver rating list contract status', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('page'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('pageSize'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalCount'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('items').that.is.an('array'); if (body.items.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('caregiverRatingId', body.items[0].ratingId); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('ratingId'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('caregiverId'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('stars'); pm.expect(body.items[0].moderationState).to.be.oneOf(['visible', 'hidden']); if (body.items[0].moderationState === 'hidden') { pm.expect(body.items[0].hiddenOnUtc).to.not.be.null; } } const raw = JSON.stringify(body); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('reviewerName'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('phoneNumber'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('email'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('avatarUrl'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('familyName'); }

request.description: Filters combine with AND: only hidden five-star ratings about the given caregiver are returned. totalCount is counted after filtering and before paging. Leave caregiverId blank to drop that filter; an unknown caregiverId is not an error.

exec: pm.test('caregiver rating filtered list contract', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); body.items.forEach(item => { pm.expect(item.stars).to.equal(5); pm.expect(item.moderationState).to.equal('hidden'); }); }

item.name: List caregiver ratings (invalid filters are rejected)

request.description: Every invalid filter answers 400 Caregivers.Rating.InvalidQuery rather than a silently different result set: stars 9 is outside 1-5, moderation maybe is not visible/hidden/all, page 0 is below 1 and pageSize 500 is above 100. Validation is explicit in the handler so the code is the documented one, not a generic validation envelope.

exec: pm.test('invalid caregiver rating filter contract', () => pm.expect([400, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: CaregiverReviewAdmin. 204 No Content. Hiding is a visibility control, not an accuracy judgement: stars, review text, reviewer and history are retained and restore is always available. The rating leaves every non-admin read, both stored caregiver aggregates are recomputed over the non-hidden set in the same transaction, and the CMS landing testimonial resolver skips it. reason is required, trimmed and at most 500 characters (400 Caregivers.Rating.InvalidReason); an unknown rating id is 404 Caregivers.Rating.NotFound and hiding an already hidden rating is 409 Caregivers.Rating.AlreadyHidden. Run "List caregiver ratings" first to populate caregiverRatingId.

CaregiverReviewAdmin. 204 No Content. Run after "Hide a caregiver rating": the rating returns to every non-admin read and to both aggregates, and its hide facts are cleared while the append-only action row keeps the reason it was given. Restoring an already visible rating is 409 Caregivers.Rating.AlreadyVisible, an unknown id is 404 Caregivers.Rating.NotFound and a blank or over-500-character reason is 400 Caregivers.Rating.InvalidReason.

item.name: Hide a caregiver rating (blank reason is rejected)

request.description: A missing, blank or over-500-character reason returns 400 Caregivers.Rating.InvalidReason; the value is trimmed before it is stored and before this check. Replace the body with a 501-character string to exercise the upper bound.

exec: pm.test('blank caregiver hide reason contract', () => pm.expect([400, 401, 403, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: An unknown or empty rating id returns 404 Caregivers.Rating.NotFound, checked before the reason so a bad reason never masks a missing rating.

item.name: [no-route] Keep is not a caregiver-rating verb

request.description: keep closes a Care Home rating's open owner flag, and a caregiver is not a facility owner, so the caregiver route exposes only hide and restore. This request documents that boundary; the route does not exist, so no visibility change is possible.

exec: pm.test('caregiver keep route does not exist', () => pm.expect([404, 405, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: CareHomesOperationalAdmin. Same filters, defaults and validation rules as the caregiver list, with 400 CareHomes.Rating.InvalidQuery, plus facilityId to filter one facility and flagged where true selects ratings with an open owner flag and false selects ratings without one. Ordering is unresolved-flagged first, then newest-first by createdOnUtc then rating id. Items carry the caregiver item fields with facilityId instead of caregiverId, plus unresolvedFlagId, unresolvedFlagReason and unresolvedFlaggedOnUtc; resolved flags are not part of the projection. No reviewer name, phone, email or avatar is ever projected.

exec: pm.test('care-home rating list contract status', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('page'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('pageSize'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalCount'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('items').that.is.an('array'); if (body.items.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('careHomeRatingId', body.items[0].ratingId); pm.collectionVariables.set('careHomeFacilityId', body.items[0].facilityId); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('ratingId'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('facilityId'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('unresolvedFlagId'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('unresolvedFlagReason'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('unresolvedFlaggedOnUtc'); pm.expect(body.items[0].moderationState).to.be.oneOf(['visible', 'hidden']); } const raw = JSON.stringify(body); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('reviewerName'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('phoneNumber'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('email'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('avatarUrl'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('familyName'); }

request.description: flagged=true returns only ratings with an unresolved (open) owner flag, so every item carries a non-null unresolvedFlagId, unresolvedFlagReason and unresolvedFlaggedOnUtc; flagged=false returns ratings with no open flag. A resolved flag is not part of the projection either way, and a rating that was flagged and then hidden or kept no longer appears under flagged=true.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); body.items.forEach(item => { pm.expect(item.unresolvedFlagId).to.not.be.null; pm.expect(item.unresolvedFlagReason).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(item.unresolvedFlaggedOnUtc).to.be.a('string'); }); }

item.name: List care-home ratings (invalid filters are rejected)

request.description: The Care Home list validates the same way and answers 400 CareHomes.Rating.InvalidQuery: stars 0 is outside 1-5, moderation maybe is not visible/hidden/all, pageSize 0 is below 1. flagged is a boolean, so a non-boolean value is bound as absent rather than accepted as a filter.

exec: pm.test('invalid care-home rating filter contract', () => pm.expect([400, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: CareHomesOperationalAdmin. 204 No Content. keep is Care Home only: it closes the rating's open owner flag by leaving the rating visible and changes no visibility. The resolving admin, the instant and the action taken (Kept) are recorded, the flag is cleared from the flagged filter, and the rating still carries the owner's reason in owner readback as Resolved. Keep on a rating with no open flag is 409 CareHomes.Rating.NoOpenFlag; a concurrent resolution loses the same way. Use the id from "List care-home ratings (flagged only)".

CareHomesOperationalAdmin. 204 No Content. Hiding excludes the rating from the owner page and from averageStars/ratingCount in the same transaction, and hiding a flagged rating also resolves that rating's open flag with attribution (Hidden), so it leaves the flagged filter. An unknown rating is 404 CareHomes.Rating.NotFound, hiding an already hidden rating is 409 CareHomes.Rating.AlreadyHidden, and a blank or over-500-character reason is 400 CareHomes.Rating.InvalidReason.

CareHomesOperationalAdmin. 204 No Content. Run after "Hide a care-home rating": the rating returns to the owner page and both aggregates and its hide facts are cleared, while the append-only action row keeps the reason it was given. Restoring does not reopen a resolved owner flag. Restoring an already visible rating is 409 CareHomes.Rating.AlreadyVisible.
An unknown or empty rating id returns 404 CareHomes.Rating.NotFound, checked before the reason and before any transition.

item.name: Restore a care-home rating (over-long reason is rejected)

request.description: The 500-character reason bound is shared by both targets and all five actions: replace the placeholder with a 501-character string to see 400 CareHomes.Rating.InvalidReason. The bound is checked before the transition, so an over-long reason never hides an already visible rating's 409.

exec: pm.test('over-long care-home restore reason contract', () => pm.expect([400, 204, 401, 403, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Role denial is not a rating read

request.description: Both route groups require Normal access with account_type SuperAdmin (5) or SupportAdmin (7): CaregiverReviewAdmin guards /api/v1/admin/caregivers/ratings and CareHomesOperationalAdmin guards /api/v1/admin/care-homes/ratings. ContentAdmin, FinanceAdmin, Care Home owners, Family, Elderly and Caregiver tokens are 403 and a missing, expired or non-Normal token is 401; a denied caller never receives a 200 page. Replace accessToken to exercise the denial.
